The '''Ixtlar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Planets in the sector include [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector was defended by a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]].<ref name="Warfare" />
